settings.title: Floor & Street Hockey
settings.subheading: Fast-paced, action-packed hockey gear designed for gyms, schools, and outdoor play—perfect for building teamwork, coordination, and stick skills on any surface.

settings.text: Durable, well-balanced hockey sticks designed for control, accuracy, and all-around performance—ideal for school programs, training, and recreational play.

settings.subtitle: Lightweight. Durable. School-Ready.
settings.title: Air-Flow Hockey Sticks
settings.text: Built for gym classes and recreational play, Air-Flow Hockey Sticks feature durable ABS construction and ventilated blades for smooth handling, reduced drag, and reliable performance. Available in multiple sizes and bright colors, they’re a safe, easy-to-use choice for schools and youth programs.

settings.subtitle: Strong Goalie Control
settings.title: Goalie Stick
settings.text: Designed for reliable blocking and control, this 42” goalie stick features a durable ABS ribbed shaft for long-lasting performance. Well-balanced and sturdy, it’s ideal for school gym classes, recreational play, and youth floor or street hockey programs.

settings.title: Warm Weather Hockey Balls
settings.text: Low-bounce hockey balls designed for consistent indoor and outdoor play in warm conditions. Highly visible and durable, they’re ideal for street hockey, school gyms, and recreational games.

settings.title: Cold Weather Hockey Balls
settings.text: Cold-weather hockey balls built for consistent, reliable play in chilly conditions. Durable and long-lasting, perfect for street hockey, leagues, and outdoor games.

settings.title: Perforated Practice Floor Ball
settings.text: Perforated practice floor ball for safe, controlled indoor and outdoor hockey training. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for stick handling, passing, and shooting drills.

settings.title: Hockey Equipment
settings.text: Essential gear for goalies and players, including protective pads, blockers, traps, and training cones. Durable, safe, and designed for practice or game play.
